title: Equity Bancshares, Inc. Will Announce Fourth Quarter 2025 Results on January 21, 2026
summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE:EQBK), (“Equity”), the Wichita-based holding company of Equity Bank, will release its fourth quarter financial results on Wednesday, January 21, 2026, with a press release issued after market close. Equity Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Brad Elliott and Chief Financial Officer Chris Navratil will hold a conference call and webcast to discuss earnings results on Thursday, January 22, 2026 at 10 a.m. eastern time or 9 a.m. central time. Those wishing to participate in the conference call should call the applicable number below and reference the Access Code below. United States (Local): +1 646 844 6383 United States (Toll-Free): +1 833 470 1428 Global Dial-In Numbers Access Code: 962739 To eliminate wait times, conference call participants may pre-register using this registration link .
